opening.argument: The video promotes ETH Plus through Nexium by presenting returns of up to 1.5% per day and directing viewers to click a link, create an account, and purchase the asset. It also promotes staking with an asserted 88.88 APR, ties presale access to the amount staked, and presents a possible 100X launch outcome. The description further links purchasing and staking to a presale and discloses that the creator receives a commission when viewers use the links. Taken together, these are investment and staking-return claims paired with direct purchase and account-opening instructions, even though the 100X outcome is described as only a possibility.
